BiblicalUsage: Teresh is one of the two chamberlains of King Ahasuerus who plotted to kill him. In Esther 2:21, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door. The fuller story is told on the Teresh profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Teresh shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
